hypotheses.core_claim: The ICAM1-ITGB2 interaction forms a critical adhesion signaling hub that amplifies fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition (FMT) and extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. ICAM1 upregulation on activated fibroblasts engages ITGB2 on immune cells, creating a positive feedback loop that sustains inflammatory fibrotic responses.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage1_ICAM1--ITGB2.json, blocking the ICAM1-ITGB2 interaction with Lifitegrast will reduce α-SMA expression and collagen I secretion in IPF fibroblast cultures by a measurable amount compared to untreated controls.
hypotheses.title: ICAM1-ITGB2 Axis Drives Fibroblast Activation and ECM Deposition in IPF [MoA - Immune Modulation]
hypotheses.validation_approach: Primary IPF fibroblast cultures treated with Lifitegrast (ICAM1 antagonist) vs vehicle control. Readouts: α-SMA immunofluorescence, collagen I ELISA, TGF-β1-induced FMT markers. Controls: normal lung fibroblasts, TGF-β1 positive induction control.

hypotheses.core_claim: Lovastatin, beyond its lipid-lowering effects, directly targets ITGB2 integrin function through cholesterol-dependent membrane raft disruption, reducing ITGB2-mediated fibroblast migration and invasion in IPF. This represents a repurposing opportunity leveraging existing safety data.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage3_ITGB2.json, lovastatin treatment will reduce fibroblast migration in scratch assays by a dose-dependent amount, with maximal effect at clinically achievable concentrations (10-50 μM).
hypotheses.title: Lovastatin Repurposing: ITGB2-Mediated Cholesterol-Integrin Crosstalk in IPF [Therapeutic Strategy - Drug Repurposing]
hypotheses.validation_approach: IPF fibroblast scratch wound assay with lovastatin dose-response (0.1-100 μM). Readouts: wound closure rate, β-catenin nuclear translocation, RhoA/ROCK pathway activation. Controls: simvastatin (positive control), vehicle, mevalonate rescue.

hypotheses.core_claim: The FN1-SDC2 ligand-receptor pair mediates fibroblast-ECM adhesion and migration through syndecan-2 signaling, driving fibroblast recruitment to fibrotic foci and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Disruption of this interaction reduces fibroblast invasiveness.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage1_FN1--SDC2.json, SDC2 knockdown or blocking antibodies will reduce fibroblast migration by a measurable amount in transwell assays and decrease EMT marker expression (N-cadherin, vimentin) in TGF-β1-treated epithelial cells.
hypotheses.title: FN1-SDC2 Interaction Promotes Fibroblast Migration and EMT in IPF [Cross-Target Interaction - Cell-Cell Disruption]
hypotheses.validation_approach: siRNA-mediated SDC2 knockdown in IPF fibroblasts + transwell migration assay. Parallel: SDC2-blocking antibody treatment of co-cultures. Readouts: migration distance, EMT markers by Western, collagen gel contraction. Controls: scrambled siRNA, isotype antibody.

hypotheses.core_claim: CD47, through its interaction with SIRPα on macrophages, functions as a 'don't eat me' signal that prevents clearance of activated fibroblasts and promotes pro-fibrotic macrophage polarization. Elevated CD47 in IPF creates an immune evasion mechanism sustaining fibrosis.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage1_THBS1--CD47.json, CD47 blockade with anti-CD47 antibodies will increase fibroblast phagocytosis by M2 macrophages by a measurable amount and shift macrophage cytokine profile from IL-10/TGF-β1 to IL-12/TNF-α.
hypotheses.title: CD47-Signal Regulatory Protein Axis as Immune Checkpoint in IPF Fibrosis [Novel Pathway - Immune Modulation]
hypotheses.validation_approach: Co-culture of IPF fibroblasts with M2-polarized macrophages ± anti-CD47 antibody. Readouts: fibroblast phagocytosis (flow cytometry), macrophage cytokine secretion (ELISA), fibroblast apoptosis. Controls: IgG isotype, THBS1-blocking antibody.

hypotheses.core_claim: MUC1, a transmembrane mucin upregulated on damaged alveolar epithelial cells, engages ICAM1 on infiltrating immune cells to amplify NF-κB-driven inflammatory cytokine production. This MUC1-ICAM1 axis creates a feed-forward loop sustaining epithelial injury and fibroblast activation.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage1_ICAM1--MUC1.json, MUC1-C (cytoplasmic tail) inhibition will reduce IL-6 and IL-8 secretion from IPF epithelial-fibroblast co-cultures by a measurable amount and decrease NF-κB nuclear translocation.
hypotheses.title: MUC1-ICAM1 Crosstalk Amplifies Epithelial-Inflammatory Signaling in IPF [Cross-Target Interaction]
hypotheses.validation_approach: IPF-derived alveolar epithelial cells co-cultured with fibroblasts ± MUC1-C inhibitor (GO-203). Readouts: cytokine panel (IL-6, IL-8, TGF-β1), NF-κB p65 nuclear localization, epithelial barrier function (TEER). Controls: DMSO vehicle, TNF-α positive control.

hypotheses.core_claim: LRP1 (LDL receptor-related protein 1) functions as a critical ECM clearance receptor on alveolar type 2 cells and fibroblasts. Reduced LRP1 expression or function in IPF impairs clearance of fibrinogen, thrombospondin, and other pro-fibrotic ligands, leading to ECM accumulation and sustained fibroblast activation.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage3_LRP1.json, LRP1 overexpression in IPF fibroblasts will increase clearance of fluorescently-labeled fibrinogen by a measurable amount and reduce endogenous TGF-β1 activation in conditioned media.
hypotheses.title: LRP1-Mediated Clearance Dysfunction Drives ECM Accumulation in IPF [MoA - Fibrosis Pathway]
hypotheses.validation_approach: Lentiviral LRP1 overexpression in IPF fibroblasts + fluorescent fibrinogen uptake assay. Parallel: LRP1 knockdown in normal fibroblasts. Readouts: fibrinogen clearance rate, latent TGF-β1 activation, ECM protein accumulation. Controls: empty vector, scrambled shRNA.

hypotheses.core_claim: Multiple HLA class II genes (HLA-DPA1, HLA-DPB1, HLA-DQB1, HLA-DRB1) form functional complexes with CD4+ T cells in IPF lung tissue, driving sustained adaptive immune responses that perpetuate fibroblast activation. This represents an underappreciated adaptive immune component in IPF pathogenesis.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: From stage1_HLA-DPA1--CD4.json_FAILED, CD4+ T cell depletion in IPF lung explant cultures will reduce fibroblast proliferation and collagen secretion by a measurable amount compared to untreated explants.
hypotheses.title: CD4+ T Cell-HLA Class II Interaction Sustains Adaptive Immune Response in IPF [Novel Pathway - Immune Modulation]
hypotheses.validation_approach: IPF lung explant culture ± anti-CD4 depletion antibody. Readouts: fibroblast outgrowth, collagen I deposition (Sirius Red), T cell infiltration (CD3/CD4 IHC). Controls: IgG isotype, CD8+ T cell depletion control.
